results.segment: You have an appointment about your energy account at Cranleigh Energy on 11 February 2026. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you have any questions about this letter, our reception team will be glad to help.
The £25.00 charge applied in error on 7 March has been refunded to your account.
